message.content:
Tesla hasn’t officially launched a Model S (or any other Model) in India yet, so there isn’t an official retail price published by Tesla.  
If you’re looking at what a comparable premium electric sedan might cost in India, you can expect a price in the ball‑park of **₹1.2–1.5 crore** (roughly $150 k–$190 k USD), depending on local taxes, import duties, and any future pricing strategy Tesla might adopt.  

Keep in mind that this is an estimate based on current U.S. pricing ($90–$100 k USD) plus typical Indian import duties and taxes, and the actual price could differ once Tesla enters the market.
